create_storage_config: create a StorageConfig dataclass instance with sync_batches and sync_mode settings for data storage
implement_storage_interface: implement a subclass of StorageInterface to provide a custom data storage backend
create_raw_data_pipeline: call create_raw_data_pipeline on a StorageInterface subclass to build a DataPipelineBuilder for a split
get_storage_splits: access the splits property on a StorageInterface subclass to get available dataset split names
access_storage_config: access the config property on a StorageInterface instance to retrieve its StorageConfig settings
